decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize the affinity mechanic and aggressive playstyle to quickly deploy a swarm of artifacts and creatures onto the battlefield. By taking advantage of low-cost artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring, the deck aims to generate card advantage and mana efficiency. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Metallic Rebuke to clear the way for its creatures to attack. Additionally, cards like Krark-Clan Shaman and Makeshift Munitions offer a sacrifice theme, allowing the player to further exploit their artifacts and creatures for additional value.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game with Urzatron lands while utilizing artifacts and sacrificing creatures to generate value. The deck aims to assemble the Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower combo to generate a large amount of mana. It then uses Myr Retriever and other artifacts to generate card advantage and create a board presence with Golem Foundry. It also utilizes Ashnod's Altar and Makeshift Munitions as sacrifice outlets to generate additional value. Mystical Teachings and Expedition Map help dig for key pieces of the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures onto the battlefield and using various sacrifice effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of low cost creatures, efficient removal spells, and card draw, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck also takes advantage of the affinity mechanic to reduce the cost of its powerful artifact spells, allowing for explosive turns and maintaining a high tempo throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to use cheap and efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector and Kor Skyfisher, combined with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, to apply constant pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck also focuses on generating card advantage through cards like Ichor Wellspring and Glint Hawk, and can make use of artifact lands like Rustvale Bridge and Great Furnace for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to have a fast and aggressive start, while also having some card advantage and removal options to maintain tempo.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly play cheap artifacts in order to swarm the board with creatures and gain advantages from sacrificing those artifacts. This aggressive strategy is enhanced by the affinity mechanic, which reduces the cost of casting spells based on the number of artifacts you control. The deck also includes removal spells and card draw to maintain momentum and outpace opponents. The mana base is built around artifact lands to further support the affinity strategy.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly swarm the board with low-cost creatures such as Brinebarrow Intruder, Faerie Miscreant, and Moon-Circuit Hacker. This deck utilizes tempo plays like Ninjutsu with Ninja of the Deep Hours and disruption with Spellstutter Sprite and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of card draw spells like Of One Mind and Preordain helps to maintain hand advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. The overall strategy revolves around applying early pressure while maintaining control of the game through counterspells and card advantage.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and efficiently dealing damage to the opponent using a combination of cheap and efficient creatures like Glint Hawk and Thraben Inspector, along with burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Makeshift Munitions and Barbed Batterfist to further pressure the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Ichor Wellspring and Experimental Synthesizer to generate card advantage and maintain a steady stream of threats. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive playstyle with a mix of red and white sources.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to deal direct damage. The deck takes advantage of cards like Thraben Inspector and Glint Hawk to provide additional card advantage and tempo. The mana base includes a mix of creature lands and artifact lands to ensure consistent mana supply. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a steady stream of threats to close out the game quickly.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, card draw, and counterspells. The deck aims to efficiently deal with threats on the board while gaining card advantage through spells like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour. With a strong suite of counter magic and removal, the deck looks to outvalue the opponent and establish control of the game. Gurmag Angler serves as a powerful finisher, while Fallaji Archaeologist provides card recursion and Tolarian Terror disrupts the opponent's mana base.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of card draw, counterspells, and removal spells while using Gates to fix mana and generate additional value. The deck utilizes Squadron Hawk and Sacred Cat for early defense and card advantage, with other creatures like Dawnbringer Cleric and Guardian of the Guildpact to stabilize the board. The Modern Age provides additional card draw, while cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt help control the opponent's board presence. Prismatic Strands offers protection, while Journey to Nowhere and Cast into the Fire provide removal options.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells and counter magic, while utilizing Gates to fix mana and provide additional benefits. It aims to stall the opponent's threats with cards like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands, while also generating card advantage with Squadron Hawk and Brainstorm. The win condition comes from either beating down with evasive creatures like Guardian of the Guildpact or slowly draining the opponent with The Modern Age. The deck is designed to outlast and outvalue the opponent in a grindy matchup.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate card advantage and deal damage quickly. By sacrificing artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Chromatic Star, the player can draw cards and trigger effects like Galvanic Blast and Deadly Dispute. The inclusion of creatures like Gearseeker Serpent and Myr Enforcer with affinity for artifacts allows for a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck also includes counterspells like Metallic Rebuke to protect its key pieces. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently using artifacts to overwhelm the opponent with damage and card advantage.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. Using mana ramp cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl, the deck aims to accelerate its mana production to cast powerful spells like Skred and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss. By efficiently controlling the board with removal spells and land destruction, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victories through fast aggression and resource denial.

The main concept behind this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats with burn spells, and drawing cards efficiently. By utilizing cheap counter spells, removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Skred, and card draw with Augur of Bolas and Frantic Inventory, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite also provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy and apply pressure on the board.

The deck focuses on using walls with high toughness to generate mana and protect itself while assembling a combo with creatures like Axebane Guardian and Galvanic Alchemist. By ramping up mana through walls and using cards like Freed from the Real, the deck can generate infinite mana to cast powerful spells or activate abilities. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help to dig for combo pieces, while cards like Mnemonic Wall and Reaping the Graves provide recursion. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a sudden burst of mana and finish them off quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key idea is to use low-cost creatures like Goliath Paladin and Inspiring Overseer to apply pressure, while also utilizing removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere to clear the opponent's threats. The deck also includes cards like Prismatic Strands and Palace Sentinels for protection and card advantage. By maintaining a fast-paced offensive strategy combined with removal and protection, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to effectively control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and generating card advantage. The deck runs efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Gurmag Angler, along with a variety of removal and counter spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card draw spells like Brainstorm and Deep Analysis to maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through a combination of control and creature beatdown.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize flickering effects to generate card advantage and maintain board control. Cards like Archaeomancer, Saiba Cryptomancer, and Mulldrifter can be flickered with spells like Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker to allow them to re-enter the battlefield and generate additional value. This, combined with cards like Meeting of Minds and Snap, allows the deck to draw cards and control the opponent's resources. The deck also uses cheap creatures like God-Pharaoh's Faithful and Sunscape Familiar to mitigate early aggression and create a solid foundation for its combo strategy.

This deck focuses on using control elements to stall and disrupt the opponent while generating value through card draw and recasting spells with Ephemerate. The key strategy is to outlast the opponent by countering threats, flickering key creatures like Mnemonic Wall and Archaeomancer, and utilizing God-Pharaoh's Faithful to gain life and survive until the late game. With efficient card draw and mana fixing, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful card advantage and recurring spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources through removal spells like Cast Down, Snuff Out, and Chainer's Edict. It also utilizes efficient creatures like Avenging Hunter and Llanowar Visionary to apply pressure and generate card advantage. The deck includes recursion with Thorn of the Black Rose and Golgari Rot Farm to ensure long-term advantage. Additionally, there are utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Vault of Whispers to disrupt opponent strategies. Overall, the deck aims to grind out the opponent and outvalue them with its synergistic cards.

This Golgari / Jund Garden deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and board wipes, while also utilizing creatures with lifelink and card draw to outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to keep the board clear with cards like Crypt Rats, Chainer's Edict, and Deadly Dispute, while generating card advantage with Ichor Wellspring and Reckoner's Bargain. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Cast Down and Snuff Out, along with lifegain and graveyard recursion to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient red spells and creatures, capitalizing on their speed and damage potential to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. By utilizing a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells, this deck aims to control the board and end the game quickly through calculated aggression and burn spells, emphasizing efficiency and speed in its strategy.

The deck focuses on low-cost, evasive creatures like Faeries and Ninjas to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It utilizes cheap counterspells and bounce spells to disrupt enemy strategies and protect its own creatures. Mutagenic Growth and Spell Pierce provide additional protection and removal options. Of One Mind helps maintain card advantage while Moon-Circuit Hacker and Ninja of the Deep Hours provide card draw. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of small, difficult-to-block creatures while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and bounce spells.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly play low-cost creatures and control spells to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of fast, aggressive attacks. By utilizing cards like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite, the deck focuses on efficient creatures and counter spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while constantly applying pressure. With a focus on card draw and evasion, this Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a swift victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using Goblin creatures along with sacrifice and graveyard manipulation effects to generate value through sacrificing creatures and artifacts, as well as achieving a combo finish with Flamewave Invoker. It also includes card draw and mana ramp to ensure consistency in executing its game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes artifact lands to help with mana fixing and synergies with sacrifice effects.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying cheap creatures and efficiently burning down opponents with direct damage spells. The deck aims to maintain aggression through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage spells to control the board and secure victory. With a mix of artifact creatures for flexibility and powerful burn spells for reach, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents early and maintain pressure throughout the game. The use of artifacts and spells allows for versatile and unpredictable plays, keeping opponents on their toes.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures and burn spells. The creatures like Thraben Inspector, Kor Skyfisher, and Glint Hawk provide early aggression, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast offer direct damage to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes some artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Ichor Wellspring for card advantage and disruption. The mana base consists of lands that can produce both white and red mana to support the aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Urzatron lands - Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower - to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently. This allows for the casting of powerful spells and abilities from the control archetype, while also generating value through sacrificing artifacts like Myr Retriever and Ichor Wellspring. The deck also includes various synergies with sacrificing artifacts and generating tokens, creating a versatile playstyle that combines ramp, control, and token strategies to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana using the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) in order to play powerful spells and control the game. Cards like Myr Retriever and Expedition Map help to ramp up the mana quickly, while cards like Ashnod's Altar and Golem Foundry provide additional utility and threats on the board. The deck also includes some card draw and removal options to help maintain control of the game and outpace the opponent.
